operationalisation.spacing: the frozen spacing is <= 0.16 mm (register section 2; the gap at least 0.625 spacings). Stage 1 uses 0.16 mm nominal (5,984 samples, 17,952 unknowns; its mean spacing sqrt(area/count) is 0.1457 mm): the coarsest that meets the rule, and a level of M1's ladder below.
operationalisation.reused: nothing at the frozen spacing exists: the cap fix's saved 6 x 6 resistance (the cap fix's second run's forward record, sha256 46f41b00...) is at 0.178 mm, so it is reused only for the reproduction checks (C1's immediate check, review 1's sizes), never as a reading of record.
operationalisation.reading_of_record: the static reading at the floored pose with the magnet's force and torque: the pose held, U along the tube and the turning Omega about it free, the force along the tube and the torque about it balanced against -R [U; Omega] (the lock's lag set by the torque); the transverse torque reacted by the held pose and reported. Its mean over a turn of the magnet is U(s). The zero-lag reading (C1's immediate check's and review 1's convention) is reported beside it. Both are frictionless and Stokes (no inertia).
operationalisation.phases: R between the eight solved phases is their trigonometric interpolant in 2 phi; positive definiteness is checked on 2,048 phases of the half turn, which covers every phase a reading uses; wall_accepted is the node's at the eight solved poses (every position reuses them).
operationalisation.field: MIME's point dipole (mime.nodes.actuation._point_dipole.point_dipole), 18.89 A m^2 (read), 150 mm above the tube's axis over s = 0 (read: 15 cm above the vessel's centre), turning across the tube at 10 Hz; the body's 1.68e-3 A m^2 at its centre; F = G^T m and T = m x B, the magnetic laws' own formulas.
operationalisation.window_and_metric: U(s) on the frozen grid s = -2.00 to +2.00 cm every 0.25 cm (17 positions). Per direction the time-weighted slope 2L / int ds/u by the trapezoid rule on that grid; the stall, if u <= 0 at any grid point, is the first such position along the pass, linearly interpolated, and is the result. A 0.01 cm grid is a diagnostic (the stall's position and the quadrature), not the reading of record.
operationalisation.A: the same reading in script A's uniform field (1.2 mT, no gradient): the eight phases' mean axial speed.
operationalisation.incline_control: 0.05 deg, downhill along +x: an axial force W sin(0.05 deg) = 2.11e-7 N (W = 2.422e-4 N from script A's mass and volume). (a) In A's uniform field each direction moves by +-F <1/R_xx> (the eight phases' mean) within 1e-3 relative, and the two-direction mean by under 1e-3 of that. (b) With the magnet, where a pass reaches the window's end, its slope moves by the first-order (V^2/2L) int du/u^2 ds within 10% and in the incline's sense; where a pass stalls with and without the plant, its stall moves by -du/(du/ds) at the stall (dense grid) within 10%, downhill. The register's control is stated for a slope; when the pass stalls there is no slope, and (b)'s stall form is this brief's reading of it, for the maintainer.
operationalisation.every_reading_checks: a reading with a non-positive smallest eigenvalue, a non-finite resistance or a refused wall read stops the stage (Modal side, per phase).
